1477-2364-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-2364-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Mana Vault, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

240-4742-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

4279-4616-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4616-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1545-1981-2415-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2738-2921-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1739-1895-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Aura Costing One Mana that Enchants Creatures

3317-3953-4050--163.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with the Aura attached, adding one mana of any color.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling the Aura and allowing you to cast it until your next turn.
Cast the Aura from exile by paying its mana cost, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When the Aura enters, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1417-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

6738-7011-7082-7297.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
6738-7011-7082-7297.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1395-3713-5078-5268.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

539-6798-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2955-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2955-6991.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1402-2644-4763-6968.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-3495-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3495-5147.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3495-5147.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

3239-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

4693-5721-6763-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
4693-5721-6763-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1850-5413-6701.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5413-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

934-4508-5880-6291.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

880-5671-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5671-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3594-4067-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
3594-4067-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Toothy triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

141-4013-6569.description:
Cast Skittering Invasion by paying {7}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Skittering Invasion.
Resolve the copy of Skittering Invasion, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

325-1786-5437-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1786-5437-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

969-1270-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

2034-4484-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-5631.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2558-3698-5346-5433.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Goblin token.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6176.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6176.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Undergrowth Champion trigger.
Resolve the Undergrowth Champion trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

643-1238-2292-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

1722-5231-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1722-5231-5572.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

1947-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Reckless Barbarian.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
1947-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Reckless Barbarian due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

586-4050-5128.notablePrerequisites: Priest of Gix has a sticker on it.
586-4050-5128.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {B}.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

643-3510-3875-4694.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand, and are able to play a land this turn.
643-3510-3875-4694.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
The Food or Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling artifact creature that is also a Forest land due to March of the Machines, Life and Limb, and Maskwood Nexus.
Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

1171-4428-4872.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Regrowth using Garth's ability.
Garth does not have summoning sickness.
1171-4428-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Garth.
Repeat each turn.

1020-3689-4050-4908-4947.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {1}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {2}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana and creature tokens, you may use them to activate Sai's ability to draw infinite cards.
